tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Amount Shown in the Portal is Inclusive Of Gst Hence Bidder Should Quote IncludingOf Gst
All other document uploads as per bid documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should be registered under GST and should submit proof of filing GST returns forthe past 8 tax periods
The bidder shall provide documentary proof of IT returns filed for previous two financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder bidding for the following items should have turnover of amount as mentioned in the table below for in any of these audited financial years (2023-24, 2024-25,2025-26) from IT Enabled Services / Computers, Scanners, Printers and Rover Supplies (whichever is applicable for the bidded item/ items) and should have a positive net worth.Average Annual Turnover in Last2 years Rs. 2 Crores

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should furnish copy of the Registration document where the Company/Proprietorship/ Partnership is registered under Indian Companies Act 1956 or 2013/Partnership Act 1932 / Shops and Establishment Act/Limited Liability Partnership, etc.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall be authorized dealer and shall submit Manufacturer Authorization Form MAF as per Annexure 3or if Bidder is OEM declaration shall be furnished to that effect as per Annexure-3
The bidder should be ISO 9001: 2015, 20000-1:2018 & 14001:2015 certified and in business for the last 2 years.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Copy of Valid Certificate to be enclosed.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of Valid Certificate to be enclosed.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have supplied the equipment(s) similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least 80% of the quantity required in any one of the 2 years. (If the bidder is a manufacturer should have supplied 80% of the requirements in last 2 years. If he is authorized dealer should have supplied 30% of the requirement). The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after 01.01.2024.,The bidders should have experience of supplying minimum quantity as mentioned in Clause 7(a) above to a Central or State Government / UrbanLocal Bodies / Government Departments.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Customer PO copy and confirmation letter from the authority for having successfully executed the contract to be enclosed.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Customer PO copy and confirmation letter from the authority for having successfully executed the contract to be enclosed.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Company information shall be furnished as per Annexure 4. The Bidder/OEM should have dedicated customer care number and mail address in their website. After raising any complaints on Rover from any part of Karnataka Bidder needs to collect the faulty unit from district headquarter and replace with stand by unit immediately and shall return the instrument after service within10 days. All the logistics cost should beborne by bidder.
The bidder should not have been blacklisted by any organization of Karnataka or in any other State Government or Central Government or PSU undertakings for anyreason whatsoever
